image_description: A close-up, low-light photograph of an assault rifle, specifically resembling an MP5 submachine gun variant. The image shows the receiver, pistol grip, magazine well with a inserted magazine, and part of the barrel/handguard. There is visible text on the upper receiver area that appears distorted or stylized. A coiled cable is attached to the rear right side.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is white lettering on the top of the receiver that is illegible and structurally nonsensical, resembling AI-generated hallucinated text rather than standard military markings.
The vertical ribs on the magazine appear slightly warped and inconsistent in spacing, lacking the precise mechanical uniformity expected of a manufactured object.

artifact_observations.location: Rear right side, coiled cable attachment
artifact_observations.reasoning: The coiled cable attaches to the receiver in a way that lacks a clear mounting point or connector, appearing to fuse slightly with the body of the gun.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the specific model (likely MP5) is correctly identified and to confirm it falls under the 'assault rifle' or 'submachine gun' taxonomy despite visual artifacts.
To analyze the gibberish text on the top of the receiver and confirm it is not valid military marking.
To check for fusion artifacts between the magazine and the magwell, and to verify the structural integrity of the handguard.
To assess the noise levels and lighting consistency, which may mask or mimic artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the receiver
Edge sharpness between receiver and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the top of the gun. Real firearms have stamped, legible serial numbers or safety markings. AI often generates 'fake' text that looks like letters but isn't. Also, check the magazine ribs; they should be perfectly parallel and evenly spaced. Any warping is a sign of generation error. The coiled cable on the right looks suspicious—check if it physically connects to anything logical.
